player_behavior: Desktop and Android assign a request identity to AI world drafting and show a distinct cancel action while the model is generating.
Cancellation is accepted only before the draft enters validation/application; a late model response is ignored and cannot create a World, Run or partial save.
After cancellation the player sees that no World, journey or archive was created and can retry from the same creation entry point.
not_proven: Windows native package and macOS packaged WebView A-F remain unrun.
Android physical-device cancellation and authenticated provider request remain unrun because adb devices is empty.
The package hashes prove rebuilt artifacts only; they do not replace package-level player acceptance.
